description: Whether the email still looks like its design in each client's live preview: draws the email as the client shows it and as written, in a real browser, and compares the layouts element by element. Returns per client a verdict (kept = Ready, changed = Needs work, broken = Broken) with the reasons (columns that stack, a button that moved or resized, a fill or corners lost, fonts and spacing changed). Use it after editing an email to confirm a fix did not break the layout. Needs playwright-core installed beside this server and a browser (a local Chromium, or BROWSERLESS_URL); with sharp installed it also compares screenshots pixel by pixel and returns diff and aligned. Light mode, our live preview, not real inboxes.

clients.description: Client IDs to check (e.g. ['outlook-windows-legacy', 'gmail-web']). Default: all; each client takes a few seconds

format.description: Source format: 'html' (default), 'jsx' (React Email), 'mjml', or 'maizzle'. Anything but 'html' is compiled first.

html.description: The email source: HTML, or an MJML / Maizzle / React Email template when `format` says so. Pass this or `path`.

path.description: Absolute path to the email source file (.html, .htm, .mjml, .jsx, .tsx, .vue), instead of `html`. Prefer it when the email is on disk: the source stays out of your context. The extension sets `format` unless you pass one.

name: check_design
